overview_description.description:
Intravides is a team of research scientists and engineers who are passionate about Neuroscience, biology and informatics. They join forces to come up with solutions to conquer the medical world where their target audience would be medical practitioners of all ages and specialties, spanning from medical students of all levels to professional doctors and surgeons.

They are experts in Imaging, data visualization and image processing as well as mixing research with state of the art augmented/virtual reality (AR/VR) hardware and software.
Their current solution involves developing an AR system that enables neurosurgeons to practice surgery of tumor extraction with higher accuracy, less invasion as well as less post-surgery complications. They exploit the advancement in digital medical imaging techniques in building their AR based visual system from the ground up by using it as their main source of data and the backbone of their system.

product.name: Holosurgery
product.description: An augmented reality application that uses goggles to allow surgeons to access medical information and 3D surgical planning during operations.

product.name: Patient specific 3D Reconstruction
product.description: A service that reconstructs patient anatomy in 3D from medical images using a patent-pending pipeline.

product.name: Surgical Planning
product.description: A service that involves designing surgical plans with surgeons and placing reference points or implantable devices onto 3D models of patient anatomy.

product.name: Support in the OR
product.description: A service that sets up Microsoft Hololens 2 with customized software to visualize 3D models and relevant content as interactive holograms during surgical procedures, including videoconferencing capabilities for remote assistance.

product.name: Remote Assistance
product.description: An application that allows technicians or specialized medical doctors to provide remote guidance in the OR through live video and audio from the surgeon's perspective.
